act_title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

quests.title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

dialogue.t: One Podvorye Smoked Sausage, one Glupov Rye Bread, two Snowrealm Okroshkas, four Snezhnaya Shashliks, and a Rimecurrant Ice Cream for each of us, please.
None for me.
C'mon, you're still gonna have just salad, even on your day off?
Yes.
Alright, well, just four Rimecurrant Ice Creams then.
Sorry, sorry, are we late?
No, we got here early. Vodyanitsa just ordered a bunch of food.
Hehe, sounds like we're in for a treat!
Should we start things off with a toast? To Odette, and a successful performance tomorrow!
Break a leg!
Break a leg!
Break a leg!
C'mon, Odette! Join in!
You want me to toast myself?
Fine. I'll do it for you... To a great show!
Gotta at least set the mood.
No need to thank me. Anything for my favorite colleague, hehe.
So how was it playing manager these past two weeks, you two? Have you been turned off from the industry forever?

dialogue.sit: I actually found it quite enjoyable.
It was a bit more tiring than I expected...

dialogue.t: Oh, well, no surprise there. Who could be unhappy, spending time with our dear Odette?
So, what made it so great? Let's hear it!

dialogue.sit:
While enjoying the meal, you share some brief snippets with the two of them...

Observing Odette's expression, you satisfy Vodyanitsa's curiosity to the bare minimum...

dialogue.t: Ohh! That sounds great!
You should be my manager next, {NICKNAME}! We can't let all this experience go to waste.
Your schedule is really that packed?
Oh, I can make it packed. Just you watch!
